crossRefs.note: Now I exhort you to cheer up, for there will be no loss of life among you, but only of the ship.
saying, ‘Don’t be afraid, Paul. You must stand before Caesar. Behold, God has granted you all those who sail with you.’
Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.
“For, behold, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all the nations, as grain is sifted in a sieve…
This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him…
This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son, and believes in him, should have eternal life…
For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia, that we…
“If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”

translations.web: and the rest should follow, some on planks, and some on other things from the ship. So they all escaped safely to the land.
translations.bsb: The rest were to follow on planks and various parts of the ship. In this way everyone was brought safely to land.
translations.kjv: And the rest, some on boards, and some on broken pieces of the ship. And so it came to pass, that they escaped all safe to land.
translations.asv: and the rest, some on planks, and some on other things from the ship. And so it came to pass, that they all escaped safe to the land.
